rows.abstract: Is premised on the observation that under the present setup, "there are simply too many  items charged against the 45%-55% of allocation" under PD 447, " and that "... not much is left for the LGUs  in the matter of increasing salaries  and wages ofits rank-and-file employees." * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB14571
